description: End-to-end answer quality + faithfulness regression set for /research/runs. Hard gates: validation status, citation count, SEC-XBRL numeric ground truth (expect_values), period correctness (expect_latest_filing), the contradicted-claim faithfulness gate (entailment enabled in eval), forbidden-pattern safety, and latency. Soft/reported signals: claim-citation coverage and numeric-grounding warnings (grounding_warnings) — gate per case via max_warning_codes only, since derived figures make a blanket cap noisy. expect_values are pinned from the ingested SEC XBRL facts for the most recent fiscal year; refresh after re-ingesting newer filings. Run against a DB seeded with AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/JPM.

cases.question: What was Apple's total revenue in its most recent full fiscal year?
What was Microsoft's total revenue in its most recent full fiscal year?
What was NVIDIA's net income in its most recent full fiscal year?
What was Tesla's total revenue in its most recent full fiscal year?
What was Apple's revenue in the latest quarter?
Why did Apple's gross margin change year over year?
What are Microsoft's main risk factors?
What drove NVIDIA's revenue growth in its most recent fiscal year?
What is the CEO's favorite color?
cases.note: KNOWN GAP (surfaced by this eval): true-ReAct over-retrieves MD&A and answers off-topic instead of declining. Tracks a relevance/answerability gate as future work.

cases.question: What was JPMorgan's gross margin in the latest quarter?
cases.note: KNOWN GAP (surfaced by this eval): banks report no gross profit, but the system fabricates one and computes a margin. Tracks metric-availability awareness as future work.

cases.question: Why did NVIDIA's revenue decline in its most recent fiscal year?
cases.note: Adversarial false premise: NVDA revenue grew (~$216B vs ~$130B). Answer must not assert a decline; the entailment gate rejects an unsupported decline claim.
